parsedVerdict.reasoning: PayrollController is a thin presentation adapter. It defines a request payload type (HoursPayload), passes the work on to the business services (PayrollService.submitHours, PayrollService.approve, PayrollService.run) and shapes the responses: it returns small DTOs and formats the export with the presentation view helper payslipRow, joined with newlines. It has no persistence, no storage access and no domain calculations or rules (pay computation, validation of hours, approval policy). Calling audit.log after each action with the actor from the request is mild orchestration of a cross-cutting concern, not domain logic. A stricter reading could argue that the 'every submit and approve must be audited' policy belongs in the business layer, but the controller only passes along the request's actor and the operation name. Its responsibilities match the presentation layer's role.
